uncertain.note: This full-width strip also holds the first two lines of both columns. I wrote the heading 'K.', then the left-column lines (Kabal, Kabel), then the right-column line continuing κάλυξ from 0206_03 as a '~ ' paragraph. The reading order and paragraph structure of this mis-cut strip may need adjusting.
The breathing is small. It looks smooth (ἴ) rather than rough (ἵ).
The genitive endings are printed with an acute and no breathing (ίδος). I copied that as printed.
